transcript: Um, hi. So, something I'm proud of. I think I'm proud of a lot of things in my career, to be honest. In my last company we had a really good year in sales, the whole team hit the target, and I was part of that team, so I'm proud of that. Everyone worked very hard. We had a lot of meetings with clients and we did many presentations, and I helped with some of the presentations. My manager said we did a good job at the end of the year and we had a party. I also think I'm proud of how I get along with people, clients like talking to me, I'm very friendly. I remember one client, a big one, they signed with us and I was in some of the meetings with them. I don't remember the exact number but it was a big contract for us. So yeah, I think that is something I'm proud of, being part of a successful team. I want to bring that same energy here. Teamwork is the most important thing in sales for me and I always try to support my teammates whenever they need something.
